summary: The TypeScript Playwright tests compile and use Playwright APIs correctly. Locators and assertions are applied properly with awaited asynchronous calls. Test titles preserve testCaseIds. Selectors mostly use roles and labels with regex for accessibility. Subject dropdown options check uses a direct locator for options, which is valid. No hard-coded waits or placeholder URLs detected. Minor concern on the comment about adjusting expected dropdown options as it may require manual updates if UI changes. Overall tests are maintainable and assertive.

issues.description: The subject dropdown options check relies on a static expectedOptions array and a comment suggests manual adjustment. This may cause brittleness if dropdown options change in the UI.
issues.recommendation: Consider fetching dropdown options dynamically or centralizing expected options in test data to reduce maintenance overhead.
